sentences.text:
Sk. Md. Shoaid Aktarb @ Sk Shoaib Ali vs Unknown on 15 July,
2024
Author: Arijit Banerjee

Bench: Arijit Banerjee
15-07-2024 (ct. no.28) debajyoti (allowed) Crm (Db) 2075 of 2024 In re: An application for bail
under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Panskura Police Station
Case No.728 of 2023 dated 16-10-2023 under Sections 376/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and
Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
-And-
In the matter of : Sk. Md. Shoaid Aktarb @ Sk Shoaib Ali .... Petitioner.
Mr. Amitabha Karmakar, Mr. Arup Kumar Bhowmick ... For the Petitioner.
Mr. Prasun Kumar Dutta, Mr. Debarshi Brahma ... For the State.
The petitioner says that he has been falsely implicated.
There was a love affair between the petitioner and the victim girl.
The victim girl has already been examined before the learned trial Court.
The petitioner is in custody for eight months.
Only 1 out of 12 witnesses has been examined.
There is no certainty as to when the trial would conclude.
Learned counsel for the State while opposing the prayer for bail draws our attention to the deposition of the victim girl.
We find that the girl has admitted that there was a love relationship between her and the petitioner.
We also find that the victim girl refused medical examination.
On an overall assessment of the material on record and the fact that the petitioner is in custody for quite some time, we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner, namely, Sk. Md. Shoaid Aktarb @ Sk Shoaib Ali, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Signed By :
DEBAJYOTI DAS High Court of Calcutta 15 th of July 2024 05:52:45 PM Thousand),
with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, 2nd Court, Tamluk, Purba Medinipur.
